mapper.select: select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID portfolioId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME portfolioName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName,/**资产简称**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt,/**交易金额**/ t.SHARE_AMT nums,/**交易份额**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE unitValue,/**单位净值**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT mdateSettleAmt,/**结算金额**/
stl.MY_ACCT_NO trdAcctId/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='02' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='02' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
